EPISODE_NARRATIVE: Rain showers produced heavy rain of 3 to 5 inches across the warned area. This led to flash flooding in Johnson county and Muscatine County.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: Rapid Creek at Wilson's Orchard came out of its banks, overspreading an area the size of a football field with 2 to 3 feet of fast flowing water. Access to the south side of the orchard was cut off.
